categories.name: mempool
categories.evidence: Lacks mempool area label and only adds a trivial getter in txmempool.h to serve an RPC caller without altering mempool behavior or data structures.
categories.rationale: Not a mempool change; the getter is added solely to support an RPC optimization.

categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Labeled RPC/REST/ZMQ and modifies MempoolInfoToJSON in src/rpc/mempool.cpp.
categories.rationale: Avoids copying the unbroadcast txid set under lock during getmempoolinfo, but the performance gain is negligible under typical conditions (10,000 unbroadcast entries saves ~0.9 ms).
